source: DMMM 2026 questionnaire level definitions (DMMM Questionnaire, columns F-J of each GDM-managed row)

policy.note: All GDM values (0-4) from the Global Metrics file are accepted automatically (decision 2026-10-14). GDM is responsible for checking all Level 4 conditions before entering a 4. Reviewers can still Override, Reject or Exclude any row in the Validation Queue. Set level4_requires_explicit_verification to true to require an explicit approval for every 4 again.

technical_seo_health.level4_conditions: Health Score 90+ AND Core Web Vitals 'Good' URL rate >= 75% AND no critical issues in the last 12 months. All three conditions required.

level_definitions.60: 0 not measured | 1 Lighthouse composite <60 or accessibility <70 | 2 composite 60-74 and CWV pass 50%+ | 3 composite 75-84, CWV pass 75%+, no critical WCAG 2.1 AA violations | 4 composite 85+, CWV pass 90%+, zero critical WCAG 2.1 AA violations on top-5 pages
level_definitions.69: 0 <40 | 1 40-59 | 2 60-74 | 3 75-89 | 4 90+ AND CWV Good URL rate >= 75% AND no critical issues in 12 months
level_definitions.89: 0 none | 1 1-2 capabilities | 2 3-4 | 3 5-6 incl. Journey Builder | 4 7+ incl. Journey Builder plus advanced/AI
level_definitions.90: 0 hard bounce >5% or no sending | 1 3-5%, <25% active | 2 1-3%, 25-49% active | 3 <1%, 50-74% active, unsub <0.5% | 4 <0.5%, 75%+ active, unsub <0.2%, automated hygiene
